title: Pork Loins with Cheesy stuffing – January 2002

pork loins

oz butter

size lump of stilton

size lump of stilton

teaspoon oregano
3
cloves garlic

Method:-
Preheat oven to gas mark 4
Soften in microwave for 45 seconds on medium and mash with fork.
Chill in fridge.
Take 4 pork loins and flatten under cling film (lots of bashing until quite thin).
Roll a spoonful of filling in pork and seal with wooden skewer.
Put pork on deepish tray and bake for 30-45 minutes
